suggested_metrics.name: Total Conversions
suggested_metrics.formula: SUM(CASE WHEN converted_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

suggested_metrics.name: Conversion Rate
suggested_metrics.formula: SUM(CASE WHEN converted_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(interaction_id)

suggested_metrics.name: Cost per Conversion
suggested_metrics.formula: SUM(cost_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN converted_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)
